page.notes: The stroke above "mutata" (after "non") is unclear and may be a reference mark or a stain; I left it out. "Praevila" is uncertain; the printed letter may be "a" or "i". The verse line set in italics has a leading em dash, and the asterisk before "mille" is treated as a reference mark to the left note. The catchword "gio" completes "effugio". The bottom foot paragraph is empty and should be removed.
